name: IEEE 4 Node Test Feeder, D-D step-up, balanced
description: IEEE PES Distribution System Analysis Subcommittee, IEEE 4 Node Test Feeder (W. H. Kersting), published case D-D (delta - delta) step-up, balanced load, 1800 kW at 0.9 pf lagging on each phase pair, the load DELTA connected (the secondary is a three-wire system). Infinite 12.47 kV source at node 1; three-wire lines 1-2 (2000 ft) and 3-4 (2500 ft); 6000 kVA 12.47/24.9 kV delta / delta transformer 2-3 (no phase shift) with Z = 1.0 + j6.0 % (equal winding impedances); delta constant-power load at node 4. Line codes as in the D-GrY files (published geometry, Kersting's modified Carson equations; the four-wire code Kron-reduced, the three-wire code without a neutral). Published node voltages: tests/GridSim.Tests/Dist3phDeltaSecondaryTransformerTests.cs (also tabulated in the LBL Modelica Buildings library, IEEETests.Test4NodesFeeder).
